cards.name: Omen Is Wrath
cards.text:
Do any of the following any number of times equal to the amount of omen
 - 3 {omen}: Choose a player to draw a card
 - 2 {omen}: Choose a player to gain an action
 - 2 {omen}: Deal 1 damage
 - 1 {omen}: Ready a character card in play

cards.name: Deja Vu
cards.text:
When any player plays an Action, pay its {gold} cost and add its {omen} to the pool. 
Resolve its effect again. You may choose new targets.

cards.name: The Night Of Emnits Shadow
cards.text:
If dread has triggered this round, remove a storyline card that would deal {damage} and heal 3 from each player.

Otherwise, heal 2
